description: Deep-dive email deliverability check for a domain: MX records + reverse-DNS (PTR) on each MX host, common DKIM selector probing, SPF lookup-count (RFC 7208 caps at 10), DMARC policy strength, and DNSBL blacklist lookups (Spamhaus Zen, SpamCop, Barracuda) on MX IPs. Note: public-resolver DNSBL queries are frequently rate-limited or blocked by Spamhaus, so a `listed: null` result means "unknown", not "clean" — treat null results as inconclusive, not as a clean bill of health.

domain.description: Bare domain to check, e.g. example.com

name: email_deliverability_check
